title: Uncontrolled resource allocation in Elasticsearch mapping updates can lead to denial of service. (CVE-2026-133919)
description: CVE-2026-133919 is a vulnerability in Elasticsearch where uncontrolled resource allocation during mapping updates can cause denial of service. An authenticated user with index-management privileges can submit crafted mapping updates that expand into large in-memory structures, exhausting heap memory and crashing the node.
